uw.name: University of Warsaw

description.en: The University of Warsaw is the largest and most prestigious research university in Poland. It offers a wide array of English-medium undergraduate and graduate programs.
description.uz: Varshava universiteti Polshaning eng yirik va nufuzli ilmiy tadqiqot universitetidir. Ingliz tilidagi ko'plab bakalavr va magistratura dasturlarini taklif etadi.

faculties: Faculty of Mathematics, Informatics and Mechanics
Faculty of Political Science and International Studies
requirements: High School Diploma (Matura equivalent) with Apostille
Certified translation of documents into Polish

uj.name: Jagiellonian University

description.en: One of Europe's oldest universities, founded in 1364 by King Casimir the Great. Renowned for Medicine, Law, Philosophy, and International Studies.
description.uz: Yevropaning eng qadimiy universitetlaridan biri, 1364-yilda tashkil etilgan. Tibbiyot, Huquq, Falsafa va Xalqaro munosabatlar yo'nalishlarida mashhur.

faculties: Faculty of International and Political Studies
Faculty of Physics, Astronomy and Applied CS
Faculty of Biochemistry, Biophysics and Biotechnology

pw.name: Warsaw University of Technology

description.en: The leading technical university in Central Europe, producing top software engineers, architects, data scientists, and robotics specialists.
description.uz: Markaziy Yevropadagi yetakchi texnika universiteti bo'lib, eng yaxshi dasturchilar, arxitektorlar va muhandislarni tayyorlaydi.

faculties: Faculty of Electronics and Information Technology
Faculty of Mathematics and Information Science
Faculty of Power and Aeronautical Engineering
requirements: High school diploma with Mathematics & Physics grades

agh.name: AGH University of Krakow

description.en: A modern technical university with world-class laboratories, computer science centers, and strong industry partnerships with global tech giants.
description.uz: Zamonaviy laboratoriyalar, IT markazlari va jahon texnologiya gigantlari bilan mustahkam hamkorlikka ega nufuzli texnika universiteti.

faculties: Faculty of Computer Science, Electronics and Telecom
Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Robotics

pwr.name: Wrocław University of Science and Technology

description.en: Located in Poland's Silicon Valley (Wrocław), PWr offers exceptional technical education, high graduate employment, and modern campus facilities.
description.uz: Polshaning IT markazi (Vrotslav) shahrida joylashgan bo'lib, yuqori ish bilan ta'minlanish darajasi va zamonaviy kampusga ega.

faculties: Faculty of Information and Communication Technology
Faculty of Mechanical and Power Engineering

amu.name: Adam Mickiewicz University

description.en: One of the largest Polish universities, offering outstanding programs in Humanities, Social Sciences, Natural Sciences, and Linguistics in Poznań.
description.uz: Poznan shahrida joylashgan bo'lib, Gumanitar, Ijtimoiy, Tabiiy fanlar va Tilshunoslik bo'yicha yetakchi hisoblanadi.

faculties: Faculty of Psychology and Cognitive Science
requirements: English B2 or Polish B2 (depending on track)

kozminski.name: Kozminski University
kozminski.ranking: #1 Private Business University in Central Europe (FT Ranked)

description.en: Triple-crown accredited (EQUIS, AMBA, AACSB) top-ranked international business school offering premier degrees in Management, Finance, and AI.
description.uz: Xalqaro 'Triple Crown' (EQUIS, AMBA, AACSB) akkreditatsiyasiga ega, Yevropadagi yetakchi xususiy biznes va moliya universiteti.

faculties: Center for AI and Digital Transformation

swps.name: SWPS University of Social Sciences and Humanities

description.en: Poland's top university for Psychology, Design, Law, and Social Sciences with campuses in Warsaw, Wrocław, Poznań, Kraków, and Katowice.
description.uz: Polshaning Psixologiya, Dizayn va Ijtimoiy fanlar bo'yicha 1-raqamli xususiy universiteti.

faculties: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

sgh.name: SGH Warsaw School of Economics

description.en: The oldest and most prestigious economics and business university in Poland, renowned for producing ministers, CEOs, and financial leaders.
description.uz: Polshaning eng qadimiy va nufuzli iqtisodiyot universiteti bo'lib, yetakchi iqtisodchilar va moliyachilarni yetishtirib chiqaradi.

requirements: High school diploma with Mathematics emphasis

pg.name: Gdańsk University of Technology
pg.ranking: Top Technical University on Baltic Coast

description.en: A historic Baltic university offering strong engineering, architecture, electronics, and maritime technology programs.
description.uz: Boltiq bo'yidagi qadimiy texnika universiteti; muhandislik, IT va dengiz texnologiyalari bo'yicha mashhur.

faculties: Faculty of Electronics, Telecom and Informatics
Faculty of Civil and Environmental Engineering
Faculty of Applied Physics and Mathematics

desc.en: Color scan of the information page with photo, valid for at least 18 months from intended intake.
desc.uz: Suratli ma'lumot sahifasining rangli skaner nusxasi. Amal qilish muddati kamida 18 oy bo'lishi kerak.

desc.en: Original diploma certificate along with full academic transcript and grade sheet.
desc.uz: Original attestat yoki diplom hamda barcha baholar ilovasi (transkript).

desc.en: Official Apostille stamp on the original diploma issued by the Ministry of Justice / Education in home country.
desc.uz: Adliya vazirligi yoki Ta'lim inspeksiyasi tomonidan original diplomga qo'yilgan rasmiy Apostil muhri.

desc.en: Translation made by a Sworn Polish Translator registered with Polish Ministry of Justice or Embassy.
desc.uz: Polsha Adliya vazirligi ro'yxatidagi qasamyodli tarjimon (Tłumacz Przysięgły) yoki Elchixona tarjimasi.

desc.en: Official IELTS (min 6.0), TOEFL (min 75), PTE, Duolingo, or University Internal English Exam pass slip.
desc.uz: IELTS (kamida 6.0), TOEFL (kamida 75), Duolingo (105+) yoki ichki imtihon natijasi.

desc.en: Official confirmation that your previous diploma grants right to continue higher education in the issuing country.
desc.uz: Oldingi ta'lim muassasasidan diplom keyingi bosqichda o'qish huquqini berishi haqidagi ma'lumotnoma.

desc.en: Recent white background biometric passport-sized photo in high resolution.
desc.uz: Oq fondagi so'nggi 3.5x4.5 sm o'lchamdagi sifatli biometrik fotosurat.

text.en: Krakow is such a magical student city. The NAWA recognition process was super smooth with PTU guidance.
text.uz: Krakov talabalar uchun ajoyib shahar. NAWA nostrifikatsiya jarayoni PTU ko'rsatmalari bilan juda oson kechdi.
